duration_s.description: Total length in seconds after transitions. Beats share it by weight.

items.label: Edit one word, re-render one scene

beats.description: One entry per scene, in order: usually hook, reveal, fact, cta.

id.description: Optional scene id (used in every data-mosio-id). Defaults to the role name; a repeated role gets -2, -3.

role.description: What this beat does in the story; picks the scene template.

text.description: The words on screen, written literally into the scene HTML.

key.description: The word or words of the text to stress with the accent colour. Must occur in the text.

weight.description: Relative screen time of this beat.

kicker.description: Hook only: the small label above the headline, for example New this season.

price.description: Hook only: the price line shown in the accent colour. Leave empty for no price.

items.description: Reveal: the product variants, 1 to 3 cards. Fact: the feature lines (label only), 2 to 3 of them.

label.description: Card name (reveal) or feature line (fact). The reveal template allows 14 characters, the fact template 40.

image.description: Optional path to a PNG or JPEG of the variant, relative to the params file. Without it the card shows a drawn tile in the brand colours.

button.description: CTA only: the text on the button.

style.description: Look: brand colours, type size and motion speed.

brand.description: Brand colours. They are written to shared/tokens.css, so changing one re-renders every scene.

bg.description: Background colour of every scene (--bg in shared/tokens.css).

main.description: Main brand colour: large shapes and the key surface (--main).

accent.description: Accent colour for the one thing that matters on screen: key word, winner bar, price (--accent).

text_on_accent.description: Text colour used on top of the accent colour, for example on a button (--text-on-accent).

font_scale.description: Multiplier on every type size (--type-scale). 1 is the designed size; check `mosio inspect` for overflow above 1.

pacing.description: Speed of the motion inside each scene: calm slows entrances by about 30 percent, brisk speeds them by about 25 percent. Scene lengths do not change.

# product-ad

A four-beat product spot: hook with price, product reveal on cards, three proof features, call to action that holds still. No photo assets are needed: cards show drawn tiles in the brand colours, or your own images.

Source: `fixtures/w3-promo` (hook, product cards, feature list and call-to-action scenes), re-authored with brand tokens and without its image and video assets.

## Beats
| role | template | looks like | limit |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hook` | `scenes/hook.html` | kicker, headline, price pops and settles | 8 words; `kicker`, `price` optional |
| `reveal` | `scenes/reveal.html` | 1 to 3 cards fly up in turn, slow push-in on each | 6 words; labels at most 14 characters |
| `fact` | `scenes/features.html` | 2 to 3 numbered feature rows slide in | 6 words; feature lines at most 40 characters |
| `cta` | `scenes/cta.html` | title, then an accent pill button, then stillness | 6 words; `button` optional |

Cards may carry `image` (a path relative to the params file). The applier copies it into `assets/img/` and declares it. 3 to 5 beats, 8 to 45 s.

## The controls worth changing first
- `style.brand.accent`: price, kicker, button, highlighted words.
- `content.beats[0].price` and `.kicker`: the offer. A direct edit re-renders only the hook.
- `style.pacing` and `style.font_scale`: motion speed and type size.

## Taste
- One offer per ad. Price once, in the hook, and the button text says the action.
- The last beat should hold still for 2 seconds or more: give the others `short` weights if time is tight.
- Three features is plenty; the third should be the one that closes.
- Use real product images when you have them (`items[].image`); the drawn tiles are placeholders.

## After applying
The result is an ordinary Mosio project: edit words in place, change a brand token in `shared/tokens.css` and only the scenes that import it re-render.

# Product advertisement: beat plan

Length 8 to 45 s (default 15). Roles: hook, reveal, fact, cta; 3 to 5 beats.
Tempo per beat (seconds): short 2, medium 3, long 4.

## hook

- scene: scenes/hook.html
- technique: kicker, headline and price rise in sequence; the price pops and pulses
- primitives: rise-fade, pop
- limits: {"max_words": 8}

## reveal

- scene: scenes/reveal.html
- technique: 1 to 3 cards fly up one after another with a slow push-in on each picture or tile
- primitives: rise-fade, push-in
- limits: {"item_label_max": 14, "items_max": 3, "items_min": 1, "max_words": 6}

## fact

- scene: scenes/features.html
- technique: numbered feature rows slide in with a stagger
- primitives: slide-in
- limits: {"item_label_max": 40, "items_max": 3, "items_min": 2, "max_words": 6}

## cta

- scene: scenes/cta.html
- technique: title then a pill button in the accent colour, then everything holds still
- primitives: rise-fade
- limits: {"max_words": 6}

## Controls

- Accent colour (`/style/brand/accent`): Recolours the price, kicker, button and highlight: --accent in shared/tokens.css.
- Price line (`/content/beats/0/price`): Edit the price directly in the hook scene; only that scene re-renders.
- Pacing (`/style/pacing`): Speeds or slows every entrance: --pace in shared/tokens.css.
- Type size (`/style/font_scale`): Scales all type: --type-scale in shared/tokens.css.
